The narrative is seductively simple: rising yields mean the government is losing control of its debt spiral, geopolitical chaos is permanent, and central banks globally are hoarding physical gold to de-dollarize.

Like Bitcoin then, gold is now decoupled from its traditional macro drivers (real yields, dollar strength) and is trading on narrative momentum and structural flows (central bank buying replacing ETF flows as the price-insensitive marginal buyer).

Watch the 10Y yield: if it pushes materially above 4.68% while equities remain resilient, the opportunity cost argument for holding gold at $4,400+ becomes brutally real for retail accounts that are paying margin interest.
